ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  ADF Foods Limited has filed a routine compliance certificate under SEBI Regulation 74(5) for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Their Registrar and Share Transfer Agent confirms that all share dematerialization requests were processed correctly within prescribed timelines, including confirmation to depositories, cancellation of physical certificates, and updating the register of members. This document indicates proper adherence to regulatory requirements for share record-keeping and investor services, with no material impacts or red flags identified.
